Command.description: Command to be executed here, such as `/playanimation \@e[type=!minecraft:player] animation.humanoid.celebrating null 20`.

CustomName.description: Like nametag, but above command block; hovering text.

ExecuteOnFirstTick.description:
When  is set to cycled and conditions are done,
first command executes without .

LPCommandMode.description: `0` means impulse (single activation), `1` chain (activation when pointed to chain command block executed) and `2` cycled (forever execution between delay with condition checking).

LPConditionalMode.description: `0` means statement, `1` doesn't care about result.

LastExecution.description: When last execution has been performed.

LastOutput.description: Message recorded with last execution, requires  to be set to `true`.

LastOutputParams.description: Splitted to command parts without first slash (or symbol if slash is not provided), requires  to be set to `true`.

TickDelay.description: Delay in ticks between executions (cycled blocks) or before starting it.
